label: National Energy Emergency Status
source: Office of the President, Executive Order 110
delta: In effect since March 24, 2026; Visayas logged yellow/red alerts again Sept 11 (yellow 1-3pm & 9-10pm, red 3-9pm, 2,002MW demand vs 2,320MW supply) with Mindanao on yellow alert 1-8pm (2,545MW vs 2,652MW supply), extending the recurring pattern since the Sept 5/7/8 alerts; 31 Visayas plants and 29 Mindanao plants remain on forced outage or derated. DOE's four-pronged plan (unit restorations through Oct 3, ~253MW of new battery storage across Cebu/Panay/Leyte/Negros, transmission fixes, generator accountability) still targets a stabilized Visayas grid by October. Separately, a big-time fuel price hike hit Sept 8 (diesel +₱5.18/L, gasoline +₱4.69/L, kerosene +₱5.58/L) driven by Iran-US tensions on Strait of Hormuz tanker traffic, erasing the Sept 1 rollback
